source_review.notes: Checked current IEC 60300-3-10:2025 and IEC 60300-3-14:2024; stable IEC 60706-2, -3 and -5 records; authoritative DLA ASSIST MIL-HDBK-470 record; NASA maintainability engineering case, NESC human-exploration report, maintainability allocation paper and current R&M resources. All ten final URLs returned HTTP 200. Standard status, guidance scope and engineering synthesis are distinguished.

evidence: Reviewed restoration phase decomposition and separate logistics/administrative delay expression.
Reviewed maintainability CDF requirement and exponential/lognormal candidate models.
Reviewed detection/isolation conditional coverage expressions and denominators.
Reviewed right-censoring warning and empirical nearest-rank percentile definition.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Clock phases may overlap, and the chapter explicitly rejects blind addition when they do.

evidence: Executed maintainability-task-fixture under python3 with exact output recorded in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-065/report.json.
Recomputed seven phase totals as 35, 43, 30, 65, 52, 38 and 120 minutes.
Recomputed mean 54.7143, median 43 and empirical nearest-rank p90 120 minutes.
Confirmed five tasks within 60 minutes and six within 90 minutes.
Confirmed correct-isolation fraction 17/20 = 0.8500 and false-removal fraction 3/20 = 0.1500.
Recomputed exercise mean 55.7143, median 35, nearest-rank p90 180 and within-threshold proportions 5/7 and 6/7.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Small selected samples are explicitly denied status as population estimates or requirement demonstrations.

evidence: Confirmed M(t) is a CDF and a probability-by-time requirement is not equivalent to a mean target.
Confirmed exponential mean and CDF relation only under constant memoryless restoration rate.
Confirmed lognormal expression uses log-time parameters rather than arithmetic mean/standard deviation.
Confirmed diagnostic detection and conditional isolation require distinct numerators/denominators.
Confirmed censored incomplete tasks cannot be entered as completed at censor time.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: No repair-time distribution is assumed universal; skew, mixtures, learning and task/resource conditioning remain explicit.

evidence: Challenged maintenance concept, repair/discard/site, LRU/SRU, access, modularity, interchangeability and configuration mismatch.
Reviewed detect/isolate/safe/access/restore/reassemble/verify/authorize clocks and overlapping work.
Reviewed missed/false detection, ambiguity groups, false isolation/removal, NFF and intermittent/contextual faults.
Reviewed human reach/posture/PPE/lighting/workload, stored energy, contamination and maintenance-induced failure.
Reviewed software rollback/data/schema/credentials, remote support, cyber authorization and tool obsolescence.
Reviewed representative sampling, rehearsed experts, learning, retries, censoring, exclusions, long tails and confidence.
Reviewed spares, crew, tools, facilities, queues, supplier turnaround and common support dependencies.
Reviewed all ten examples and five complete answers for assumptions, reasoning, limitations and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Production claims require domain maintainer/operator, human-factors, safety, reliability/statistical, diagnostics/software/cybersecurity, logistics/supply, configuration, demonstration and acceptance-authority review.

evidence: Confirmed every requirement binds task/fault population, configuration, maintenance level, resources, clock and probability target.
Confirmed diagnosis, repair and verification remain distinct success gates.
Confirmed credited tools/data/spares/skills are configuration controlled and available at the maintenance level.
Confirmed means never substitute for tail/percentile evidence.
Confirmed restoration includes end-to-end function, configuration, safety/security and induced-fault checks.
Confirmed field changes update affected evidence while preserving historical baselines.
invariant_checking.notes: A quick swap or green built-in test is never presented as sufficient restoration evidence.

proof_review.notes: The chapter presents distribution identities and an evidence chain but no theorem proof.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: The executable result is labeled synthetic_task_observations_only.
The empirical p90 is labeled an order statistic, not a fitted guarantee.
IEC, DoD and NASA source status is attributed without claiming local conformance.
Demonstration and field evidence are bounded by sampling, learning, configuration and confidence.
No external review, diagnostic coverage, safe repair, population maintainability, operational availability or acceptance is claimed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Observed task arithmetic and population inference remain explicitly separate.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked maintainability/maintenance/repairability/diagnosability/testability, maintenance concepts and levels, LRU/SRU, detection/isolation/identification, coverage, false alarm/NFF, active time/downtime/MTTR, MTA, induced failure and LORA.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked concepts, requirements/allocation, repair levels, accessibility/modularity, safe states, testability/diagnostics, intermittent/NFF, software restoration, task analysis, distributions/clocks, checkout/induced faults, demonstrations/learning, observations, logistics/workforce, remote/predictive support and lifecycle feedback.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from restoration semantics through design, diagnostics, support and verification. Ten examples isolate recurring defects; five complete solutions cover requirement construction, skewed arithmetic, diagnostic design, LORA and defensible demonstration/feedback.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external IEC/DoD/NASA expert, maintainer/operator, human-factors/safety specialist, reliability statistician, diagnostic/testability engineer, software/data/cybersecurity recovery owner, logistics/supply/workforce authority, supplier/depot, independent V&V, demonstration authority, technical authority or support-policy acceptance review is claimed.
